name: Sikaplan WP Disc
paste:
SIKAPLAN® WP DISC: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikaplan® WP Disc, April 2023, Version 03.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/r/sikaplan-wp-disc.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikaplan® WP Disc where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 03.01).
1.2 Product description. Sikaplan® WP Disc is a ready to use fixing disc on base of polyvinylchloride (PVC-p).
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - For temporary and spotwise fixation of PVC-p sheet membranes
    - For temporary and spotwise fixation of geotextiles and drainage layers under sheet membranes
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikaplan® WP Disc
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Fixing disc on base of PVC-p
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Quality management system EN ISO 9001/14001
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN ISO 9001/14001: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - With predetermined breaking point against membrane overstress
    - High flexibility for easy fixation at low temperatures
    - Fast fixation with nailing gun system into shotcrete
    - Heat weldable to all PVC-p sheet membranes
    - Can be installed on wet substrates
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Round shape with smooth surface on top and centre hole for nails with washer
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Diameter: 80 mm
    - Weight: 30 g
2.7 System structure. Ancillary fixing tools (supplied by others):
    - nailing system (i.e. Hilti DX 36): nailing gun incl. cartridges, compatible Hilti nails and washers for fixations into shotcrete
    - steel spikes with steel washers (i.e. Hasko rivets) to be driven by hammering into pre-drilled holes in reinforced concrete
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 400 pcs / cardboard box
    - Shelf life: 5 years from date of production if stored properly in undamaged, unopened, original sealed packaging
    - Storage conditions: Fixing discs must be stored in their original packaging and in cool and dry conditions. They must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, etc.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 03.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality. In accordance with the requirements for the sheet waterproofing membrane to be fixed.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 03.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Thickness: 10 mm
4.3 Application method / tools - Installation method.
    - In accordance with the Sika® application manual and installation instructions.
    - Use Sika-Trocal® Cleaner 2000 for cleaning of slightly soiled membrane and Disc surface, if required.
    - The sheet waterproofing membranes are spotwise fixed with Sikaplan® WP Disc. Fix 1 piece/m² on horizontal areas and 2–4 pieces/m² on vertical and overhead areas (tunnel crown) of Sikaplan® WP Disc. Welding of sheet membrane to fixed disc must be performed with manual heat welding tool, type Leister Triac PID (or S type).
4.4 Limitations and important considerations.
    - This product shall only be used by Sika approved contractors.
    - Sikaplan® WP Disc is not UV stabilised.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +5 °C min.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikaplan® WP Disc, April 2023, Version 03.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/r/sikaplan-wp-disc.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
